name: historical-replay
details: Exact GitHub #4308 event and nine stranded PRs each delivered once; drains survive interruption; acknowledged events stay silent; new event wakes again.

name: numeric-identities
details: Real gh sent String owner/repo values on all poll and two-page sweep requests, retained integer PR numbers, and delivered nine drops.

name: interpage-retirement
details: A queued page-1 sighting retains discovery after inter-page drop; next sweep reports failed_checks once and retires only afterward.

name: failed-page-retry
details: Failed and genuinely timed-out second pages preserve last-watch discovery; successful retry delivers the previously unarmed drop.

name: seen-record-recovery
details: Malformed seen data fails only the sweep; later PR polls run in both cycles, last-watch discovery survives, and recovery delivers the missed drop.

name: mixed-repositories
details: Completed repository removal is delivered while another repository page fails.

name: template-device-recovery
details: Shipped-template + device-renumber recovery resumes polling; unshipped hash-only tampering stays refused without executing the check.

name: baseline-comparison
details: The base-commit poll is silent for the exact #4308 removal; the current poll emits the PR, failed_checks, and its real GitHub removal-event ID.

name: slow-checks-rearm
details: Completion of real custom and gh checks refreshes the existing expired beacon at unchanged default bounds; concurrent rearm preserves the running watcher, final PR and sweep drops arrive.

name: long-sweep-pages
details: Three real API pages took more than the two-second page budget in aggregate and still delivered every removal.

name: lifecycle-boundary
details: Cleanup and cross-repository rearm preserve an unobserved last-watch merge; its unarmed drop is delivered. Closed-unmerged watch retires after one empty sweep and normal cleanup succeeds.

name: force-closed-cleanup
details: Explicit --force discards the closed watch with or without a sweep; ordinary cleanup refuses pending discovery; invalid retirement receipts remain refused even with --force.

name: retained-device-renumber
details: A device-renumbered retained receipt passes unchanged-inode proof through cleanup, rearm, and restart; the drop is delivered before exact retirement.

name: reason-preservation
details: Long and Unicode GitHub reasons survive poll, sweep, and drain; controls are escaped and event-like reason text cannot replace the actual deduplication event ID.

name: later-gitlab-watch
details: The real glab CLI reads the later GitLab watch in the malformed-seen cycle and on restart, then its merge notification reaches main despite the GitHub sweep failure.

name: immutable-pagination
details: A real two-page scan retains immutable creation ordering when a later-page PR updates and drops after page 1, delivers its removal, and only then retires the merged last watch.

name: interrupted-retirement-artifacts
details: Restarts with full, registration-only, and sidecar-only interrupted retirement artifacts accept unchanged inodes after recorded-device renumber, deliver the unarmed drop, and remove only those exact artifacts.

name: unreadable-seen-recovery
details: Unreadable/unsafe seen records and a deduplication lookup corrupted after the scan begins all preserve the last-watch sidecar; every next successful scan delivers its removal before retirement.
